messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] Region us-west-2 GPU capacity exhaust / autoscaler errors. Symptoms: long queue growth, throttle responses, scale ops failing. Runbook: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/gpu-capacity-runbook :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Alert metadata: detected at 1976549960, pool gpu-pool-usw2-main saturated, avg queue 512, 95p latency 11s, autoscaler error rate high.

erin_oncall: I'm taking initial ownership. Pulling dashboards and recent deploys. Tagging @jay_sre and @dinesh_infra for infra escalation.

jay_sre: Oncall ack. Quick check: any recent code that would increase concurrent model size or change batching?

dinesh_infra: No infra deploys flagged in last hour. Noticed cloud provider throttles in telemetry for instance create API at the same timeframe.

kevin_eng_runtime: Examining autoscaler logs. Frequent entries: 
```
E 14:07:13 autoscaler: provision attempt failed: RateLimitExceeded
E 14:07:19 autoscaler: backoff expired, retrying
E 14:07:45 autoscaler: provider returned 500 on createInstance
```
Also see kube events showing pod pending due to insufficient nodes.

erin_oncall: Customer impact? Maggie, any 503s or streaming disconnect reports?

maggie_prod: Yes - hosted API high-throughput routes showing increased 5xx and stalled streams. Support tickets from 3 enterprise customers. We're classifying as P1.

sophia_support: Notification draft started. Will post to status page and escalate to flagged customers by phone.

ops-bot: Current snapshot: gpu-pool-usw2-main queue=512, gpu-pool-usw2-failover queue=60, throttled rate 11.2% of requests (5m window).

erin_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) reduce autoscaler parallelism to 1 to avoid hammering provider 2) reroute latency-sensitive routes to failover pool 3) pause nonessential internal batch jobs 4) try manual node adds in small increments 5) prepare model-fallback plan to quantized smaller variants.

dinesh_infra: Lowering autoscaler concurrency now: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/autoscaler MAX_PARALLEL_PROVISION=1` applied at 1976550025.

kevin_eng_runtime: Executing routing weight change to shift streaming traffic off main pool: 
```
redwoodctl routing set --route inference.streaming --pool gpu-pool-usw2-main --weight 0.2
redwoodctl routing set --route inference.streaming --pool gpu-pool-usw2-failover --weight 0.8
```
Applied at 1976550030.

ops-bot: Observed shift: 78% traffic -> gpu-pool-usw2-failover within 25s. Main pool still draining backlog.

jay_sre: I'll kick off manual provisioning script but with staggered spacing to avoid provider rate limit: `for i in 1..6; do sleep 12; ./scripts/provision-node --pool=gpu-pool-usw2-main; done`

kevin_eng_runtime: Manual provisioning attempts show intermittent success - 1 node attached at 1976550042, another at 1976550058. Provider support case opened referencing throttling.

maggie_prod: Posted initial status update: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1976550001 noting degraded hosted API in us-west-2.

sophia_support: Support triage: created CS list of impacted customers and sent templated message + phone outreach for two high-touch accounts.

ops-bot: Post-routing-change 95p latency on streamed routes down from 11s -> 3.6s for traffic hitting failover pool. Overall throttled proportion reduced to 7.4%.

erin_oncall: If provider rate limiting persists longer than 20m, plan B is to initiate model fallback on non-critical routes to quantized-variants. Kevin prepare rollout commands; we'll only flip if capacity doesn't recover.

kevin_eng_runtime: Ready: sample command below to reduce quality for batch routes only: 
```
redwoodctl rollout start --route inference.batch --model quantized-llama-q4 --percent 100 --reason "fallback during region provisioning"
```
Holding until we decide.

jay_sre: Manual provision cadence working; 3 nodes added by 1976550068. Queue now 238 and declining.

dinesh_infra: Noted provider-side root cause: sudden API throttling due to underlying control-plane incident with their allocation service. They report mitigation work ongoing.

erin_oncall: Good progress. Keep watching. Action items to capture: 1) autoscaler: implement circuit-breaker and per-region request pacing 2) improve fallback routing playbook with pre-made runbook snippets 3) add proactive warm spares in critical regions 4) customer comms playbook for P1 capacity events 5) cache warming investigation with Applied ML. Maggie/Jay own doc coordination.

maggie_prod: I'll draft the post-incident doc and schedule follow-up with Applied ML for cache regressions.

sophia_support: I'll consolidate impacted customer list for credits and follow-ups.

erin_oncall: Incident state: MITIGATED at 1976550078. We'll remain in monitoring for 2 hours. Postmortem meeting scheduled at 1976553600.

ops-bot: Incident marker set: MITIGATED. Next update in 60m or on regression.

jay_sre: Uploading autoscaler logs and provider request traces to /artifacts/incidents/1976550001.

kevin_eng_runtime: Noted commands used and temporary routing adjustments.

incident-bot: Page cleared. Thank you responders.
